<!--
Thanks for contributing. Please read CONTRIBUTING.md first if you have not — this is a port, so the
rule is transcribe rather than redesign, and adapt in one place rather than file by file.
-->

## What was broken

<!-- The defect, not the edit. What did the mod do, and what should it have done? -->

## What this changes

<!-- The mechanism. If you adapted something the modern engine removed, say where the adapter lives
     and why that is the one place it belongs. -->

## How you know it works

<!-- Evidence, not confidence. Test output, comparison against the original, a log from the game.
     If part of it is unverified, say which part — that is respected, an overstated claim is not. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes
- [ ] `./gradlew test` passes — no failures, no new skips
- [ ] Parity numbers printed by the test run did not drop (or the change is explained above)
- [ ] No build output, logs, dumps or IDE files added to the repository
- [ ] Existing code I touched keeps its style, naming and comment language
